WHO WE ARE 
 Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
 Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
 Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.
   WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 
 You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.
 You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.
 Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.
 Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.
   YOUR IMPACT 
 At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.
 Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.
   WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.
 Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.
 Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.
 Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.
 Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.
 Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.
 Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.
 Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care.
 Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance.
 Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations.
 Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination. 
 WHO YOU ARE 
   A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment.
 Practical electrical measurement skills.
 The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure.
 Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results.
 A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability.
 The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop.
 Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings.
 Ln2 Experience 
 Nice to have
 Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements.
 High-current DC testing or quench detection.
 Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems.
 Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding.

 Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting.

About Us
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 About The Role
 Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where guidance turns intent into a flyable path at speed. It takes a mission objective or a waypoint, produces the reference, and drives the aircraft along it. It is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software.
As a Flight Guidance & Motion Planning Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own motion planning, trajectory generation, and guidance laws, consuming imperfect, delayed inputs from the estimator and the perception pipeline and handing references to the control loop. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from optimization-based planning to learned and differentiable approaches, and decide what holds up at high speed.
 Responsibilities
 Motion Planning: Plan dynamically feasible paths onboard, including obstacle avoidance, replanning as the situation changes, and perception-aware planning. 
 Trajectory Generation: Turn those paths into feasible references under airframe and actuator limits, handed cleanly to the control loop. 
 Guidance Laws: Design the laws that steer the aircraft along the reference and hold it there. 
 Interfaces & Perception Coupling: Own the input contracts for the ego-state from Navigation and the perception pipeline, and handle their latency, rate, and dropout, including behavior when an input drops. 
 Mode & Failsafe Logic: Across cruise, loiter, and approach, including lost-link behavior. 
 Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. 
 Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers. 
 Candidate Requirements
 Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, robotics, GNC, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. 
 Motion Planning & Trajectory: Proven experience with onboard motion planning, trajectory generation, and tracking, and with guidance laws on flying platforms. 
 Perception-Coupled Control: Hands-on experience closing a control loop on a perception output, handling latency and dropout. 
 Learning-Based Methods: Familiarity with learning-based planning or guidance and simulation-based training, with the judgment to weigh it against classical approaches. 
 Professional Attributes:
 Systems-minded and pragmatic about failure modes and imperfect inputs, disciplined about simulation and validation. 
 Communicates clearly, able to present guidance and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. 
 Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. 
 Bonus: Experience with vision-based or perception-coupled guidance. 
 Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. 
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Junior-Netzwerkingenieur 
 Junior-Netzwerkingenieur 
 Über Mixvoip 
 Mixvoip ist ein in Luxemburg ansässiges Unternehmen, das Cloud-Telefonie, intelligente Netzwerklösungen und Hochgeschwindigkeits-Internetdienste anbietet. Wir entwickeln und betreiben Kommunikationssysteme, auf die sich Unternehmen tagtäglich verlassen. Wir entwickeln unsere Tools selbst – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel! Über die Stelle 
 Die meisten Menschen nutzen das Internet. Nur sehr wenige haben die Möglichkeit, einen Teil davon selbst zu betreiben. Bei Mixvoip werden Sie genau das tun: Wir betreiben unser eigenes ISP-Backbone, das sich über vier Länder erstreckt (Luxemburg, Belgien, Deutschland und Frankreich), und genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel! Wir suchen einen Nachwuchs-Netzwerkingenieur, der sich wirklich in die Materie vertiefen möchte. Nicht nur so weit, dass man „einen Büro-Switch konfiguriert“, sondern so weit, dass man BGP-Sitzungen mit dem Rest der Welt einrichtet. Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, die gerne Dinge erklären, und lernst, ein echtes ISP-Backbone zu betreiben und Fehler zu beheben, auf das sich Unternehmen tagtäglich verlassen. Kernnetz-Routing : Sie arbeiten mit BGP , OSPF , IS-IS und MPLS/LDP in unserem Backbone-Netz, einschließlich Peering mit dem restlichen Internet.
 Zugang und Übertragung : Unser Netzwerk deckt alle Bereiche ab, mit denen ein Internetdienstanbieter zu tun hat: EVPN , optische DWDM-Übertragung , FTTH-Zugang , Kundenanbindung und Rechenzentrumsvernetzung.
 Hardware : Sie unterstützen bei der Konfiguration und Wartung von Routern und Switches der Hersteller Juniper, Huawei, Cisco und MikroTik.
 Fehlerbehebung : Du wirst Vorfälle untersuchen und Paketaufzeichnungen analysieren, um nicht nur herauszufinden, was passiert ist , sondern auch warum . Sobald du dich eingearbeitet hast, wirst du in den Bereitschaftsdienst eingebunden. Wir werden dich vorher schulen, versprochen.
 Standorte : Die Tätigkeit wird zwischen unseren Büros in Steinsel und Bettembourg aufgeteilt. Gelegentlich besuchen Sie eines unserer Rechenzentren; Dienstreisen sind die Ausnahme, nicht die Regel. Nach Ihrer Einarbeitungsphase können Sie 1–2 Tage pro Woche im Homeoffice arbeiten (abhängig von den Vorschriften Ihres Wohnsitzlandes).
 Vorteile : Firmenwagen, Essensgutscheine, Betreuung durch erfahrene Ingenieure, die noch wissen, wie es ist, ganz am Anfang zu stehen, und vieles mehr, worüber wir dir gerne berichten.
 Zu Ihrer Erleichterung sollten Sie sich auf die unterstrichenen Schlüsselwörter konzentrieren. Sie wissen nicht, welche das sind? Kein Problem, das lernen Sie ganz nebenbei. Sie könnten diese Begriffe jedoch auch googeln, um zumindest eine Vorstellung davon zu bekommen, wofür sie verwendet werden. Was benötigen wir von Ihnen? 
 Bei Mixvoip legen wir mehr Wert auf Leidenschaft als auf Zeugnisse. Wir erwarten keine jahrelange Erfahrung, sondern echte Neugier. Vielleicht hast du aus Spaß RFCs gelesen, vielleicht schaust du dir um 2 Uhr morgens ununterbrochen Videos zum Thema Netzwerke an. Was wir wirklich suchen, sind Menschen, die von Netzwerken fasziniert sind und den Wunsch haben, Dinge selbstständig zu erlernen. Eine erste Zertifizierung (CCNA, JNCIA, MikroTik) oder ein einschlägiges Studium sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind wichtig, da unsere vielfältigen Teams diese Sprache als gemeinsame Kommunikationsbasis nutzen. Französisch ist von Vorteil; Deutsch und Luxemburgisch sind von Vorteil. Wenn du deine neue Rolle als Junior antrittst, ist es ganz normal, dass du nicht sofort alle Antworten parat hast. Zögere also nicht, Fragen zu stellen und um Klarheit zu bitten, wenn du sie brauchst. Du wirst von einem Team umgeben sein, das sich für dieselben Dinge begeistert wie du. Bonuspunkte für ein Heimlabor! Wenn du zu Hause etwas aufgebaut hast – sei es ein Routing-Labor, eine BGP-Konfiguration mit virtuellen Routern, einen selbst gehosteten Stack oder sonst etwas –, möchten wir das wirklich gerne sehen. Bring es zum Vorstellungsgespräch mit, zeig uns ein Diagramm und führe uns durch ein oder zwei Projekte. Das sagt uns mehr als jedes Zertifikat. Eine neue Art der Bewerbung: Werden Sie Teil der Erfolgsgeschichte von Mixvoip 
 Werden Sie Teil von Mixvoip, und Sie werden nicht nur Unternehmen mit Hochgeschwindigkeits-Internet, Glasfaser-, Satelliten-, Festnetz- oder Mobilfunknetzen verbinden, sondern auch Menschen miteinander verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und unsere Geschichte entscheidend mitgestalten. Wenn du also bereit bist, dich auf eine spannende Reise zu begeben und eine entscheidende Rolle in der Geschichte von Mixvoip zu spielen, findest du hier einen etwas anderen Weg, dich zu bewerben Wir laden Sie ein, mit Ihrem Smartphone ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo aufzunehmen. Erzählen Sie uns, warum Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren, oder stellen Sie uns Fragen bzw. äußern Sie eventuelle Bedenken. Es geht darum, den Dialog offen und lebendig zu gestalten! Bitte denken Sie daran, Ihren Lebenslauf im PDF-Format beizufügen. Anstelle eines herkömmlichen Anschreibens möchten wir Sie bitten, eine KI Ihrer Wahl einzusetzen. Dies spiegelt nicht nur unseren technologieorientierten Ansatz wider, sondern ermöglicht es Ihnen auch, Ihre Anpassungsfähigkeit an neue Werkzeuge unter Beweis zu stellen. Uns geht es weniger um das Anschreiben selbst, sondern vielmehr um Ihre Interaktion mit der KI.   PS: Möchtest du wissen, mit wem du auf diese Reise gehen wirst? Das bin ich, Marc 
 Ich bin 36 Jahre alt und leite das Netzwerkteam. Ich bin bereits 2014 zu Mixvoip gekommen, als das Unternehmen noch sehr klein war, was bedeutete, dass ich mich um so ziemlich alles kümmern musste. Seitdem habe ich dazu beigetragen, das Unternehmen und sein Netzwerk auf vier Länder und mehr als 15 POPs auszubauen, und ich habe jeden Schritt davon genossen. Ich war lange Zeit bei den Pfadfindern, und das merkt man: Ich lege Wert auf Eigenständigkeit und vertraue darauf, dass ihr die Dinge selbst in den Griff bekommt, aber Teamarbeit steht immer an erster Stelle. Außerdem bin ich fest davon überzeugt, dass eine Führungskraft mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen sollte – ihr werdet mich also nicht hinter Besprechungen verstecken sehen. Ich bin nach wie vor intensiv in den täglichen Betrieb unseres Netzwerks eingebunden und arbeite gemeinsam mit euch direkt an den Konfigurationen. In meiner Freizeit bin ich entweder mit meinem Motorrad unterwegs, auf dem Schießstand (Sportschießen ist mein Ding) oder verbringe Zeit mit meinem 3-jährigen Kind.

 Job description
 ATMOS Space Cargo is seeking an AIT Technician (m/w/d) focusing on electrical integration and avionics to support the assembly, integration and testing of our PHOENIX orbital transfer and return vehicles. Working closely with our engineering teams at our Lichtenau facility, you will contribute to the development, verification and flight readiness of our reusable spacecraft. 
 Key responsibilities 
 You will manufacture, assemble and install spacecraft wiring harnesses, including crimping, soldering, connector assembly, shielding and cable routing. 
 You will integrate avionics and electrical subsystems, including onboard computers, power distribution units, batteries, sensors, actuators and payload electronics. 
 You will perform electrical testing, including continuity, insulation resistance, grounding, power-on and functional tests. 
 You will support spacecraft integration, verification and environmental test campaigns. 
 You will work according to electrical schematics, assembly procedures and applicable ESD and workmanship standards, ensuring accurate documentation and traceability. 
 You will prepare, operate and maintain electrical ground support equipment (EGSE), test harnesses and measurement equipment. 
 You will collaborate with electrical and systems engineers to resolve integration issues and improve assembly processes. 
 Profile required
 Completed vocational training in electronics, avionics, mechatronics or a comparable technical qualification. 
 Hands-on experience in cable harness manufacturing, electrical assembly, integration and testing. 
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and technical documentation. 
 Experience with electrical test equipment, including multimeters, insulation testers and oscilloscopes. 
 Precise, structured and quality-conscious approach to technical work and documentation. 
 Good command of English; German is an advantage. 
 Willingness to work on-site in Lichtenau and travel occasionally for test and launch campaigns. 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience in aerospace or other high-reliability industries. 
 Knowledge of ECSS or IPC workmanship standards. 
 Experience in cleanroom or ESD-controlled environments. 
 Company description
 ATMOS was founded as a European company built on the values of freedom, democracy, equality, the rule of law, and human rights. We are committed to protect these values by making our technology available to others who share the same values, strengthening infrastructure and innovation for prosperity on Earth. 
 Our team is multinational and diverse, with offices in Lichtenau and Strasbourg. We work in a collegial, hands-on culture where people support each other, take ownership, and keep learning every day. Motivation for the mission comes first — building spacecraft is not a nine-to-five pursuit. We align the mission, the team, and the individual in mutual dependence. This principle shapes our work environment where exceptional people, as committed as they are competent, can grow and contribute to a mission that matters.

About Abound 
 We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.
And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.
Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.
 About the role 
 We’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our New Products & Geographies Engineering team in London. This team launches and scales new lending propositions in two directions: bringing Abound’s lending to customers in new countries and expanding our B2B offering for partners. We move quickly, exploring ideas through production-ready MVPs and iterating as products mature.
 This is a hybrid role, with at least three days a week in our London office. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.
 You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship. We value engineers who are curious about the business and are keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and customer experience.
 Our technology stack 
 Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy and Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker and AWS.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans
 Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments
 Write clean, well-tested Python, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers
 Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software
 Work closely with our React frontend developers to build the APIs and backend logic their features rely on
 Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases
 Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers
 Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows
 Who you are: 
 You’ll need:
 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects
 Working knowledge of Python – you don’t need to be an expert, but you’re comfortable writing, testing and debugging code
 An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and unit testing
 Familiarity with SQL, relational databases and Git
 To be able to work from our London office at least three days a week
 You’ll do well here if you:
 Have a sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers
 Learn quickly, take initiative and work methodically through problems, even in a large, evolving codebase
 Communicate clearly, ask questions, take on feedback and work well in a team
 Have a genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work
 Ideally you'll also have: 
 Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI
 Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker
 Knowledge of lending products or open banking
 How we work: 
 To be successful here, our culture needs to energies you. Here’s how we operate:
 High bar and real ownership: We’re a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.
 Focus on impact: We measure success by what we deliver to customers. We prioritise carefully so our energy goes where it makes the biggest difference.
 MVP and iteration culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.
 One team collaboration: We collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations and the wider business.
 Thrive in change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgement, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.
 What we offer: 
 Equity – everyone owns a piece of the company
 Hybrid working, with three days a week in the office
 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays
 2 paid volunteering days a year
 A one-month paid sabbatical after 4 years
 Employee loan
 Free gym membership through WellHub
 A team wellness budget to be active together – set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

 We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader , to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters.

items.jobTitle: Stage R&D Hardware - Banc de test multi-produits
items.jobDescription:
🚲 Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données. 
 Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition. 
 Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !
 🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.
 🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).
 Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :
 Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22) 
 Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.
 Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.
 Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.
 ✏️ Tes rôles : 
 – Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc
 – Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)
 – Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central
 – Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test
 – Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement
 – Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service
 Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose
 Ce que l’on te met à disposition : 
 Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents
 Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés
 👉 Et si c’était toi ? 
 – Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués
 – Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes
 – Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur 
 – Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement
 – Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins )
 – Curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), à l’aise en laboratoire
 L’entreprise et le projet te plaisent ? 
 « il ne faut jamais remettre au lendemain ce qu'on peut faire le jour-même » : Tu n’es pas arrivé.e jusqu’ici pour postuler « plus tard » ! C’est rapide, ça prend 2 minutes (et c’est vrai !)
 ❓ Et après ? 
 Voici ce qu’il se passera si ton parcours nous semble pouvoir correspondre aux missions que nous proposons:
 Premier échange téléphonique avec notre Chargée de recrutement Océane qui permet de confirmer les premiers prérequis et de conforter ton intérêt.
 Un entretien avec le responsable du stage
 Un retour personnalisé sur ta candidature

Role
 You’ll improve and extend the decision logic behind our battery fleet. Our optimization already runs our batteries every day; now we want to make it sharper, more robust and ready for new use cases. Our batteries sit behind the meter at industrial sites, so every decision has to balance customer savings, grid constraints and market value under uncertainty. Our data scientists and quantitative researchers work as one team and often across each other's topics.
   What you will do
 The role covers two closely linked areas. You can work in either one and switch between them as priorities and your interests evolve:
 Fleet optimization: Plan how each battery runs over the coming hours and days, combining customer savings, grid fee rules and market value within each site's limits. Forecasts of load, PV and prices are generated and fed into the plan, which has to stay robust to their uncertainty. You also measure how much value we actually capture.
 On-site control: Make the plan work in reality. Within our local control system, you design the logic that executes the schedule at each site, reacts to deviations and falls back safely when data or devices fail, while hard limits such as grid capacity, feed-in restrictions and state of charge always hold.
   Topics you'll work on
 You join work that is already running and take ownership of topics as priorities require. These are the areas where we want to add strength:
 Improving and extending our optimization models for sequential decision-making on time series, across customer savings, grid fee rules and market value.
 Making decisions more robust to forecast uncertainty (load, PV, prices).
 Developing the on-site decision logic of our local control system: MPC, constraint handling and fallbacks.
 Making sure hard constraints always hold in operation: grid connection limits, feed-in restrictions, state of charge.
 Analyzing where we lose value compared to what was possible, and simulating new use cases before go-live.
 Bringing models into production together with our engineers.
   What we are looking for
 Strong in optimization or control under uncertainty, e.g. LP/MILP, MPC, stochastic or robust optimization, state estimation or Kalman filtering.
 Experience with, or at least exposure to, predictive modeling and machine learning, or a strong background in statistics.
 Good Python skills and the ambition to write clean code that runs in production, not just in notebooks. You don't need to be a software engineer by training, but you care about code quality and use AI tools to move fast.
 You are comfortable with messy real-world time-series data and team up with our data engineers to clean and prepare it for modeling.
 You think in constraints and failure cases and make pragmatic decisions without perfect requirements.
 You enjoy working closely in a small team, learning each other's topics and covering for each other.
 Nice to have: battery storage, microgrids or energy management; using probabilistic forecasts in decision-making; German energy markets and regulation.
   What it means to work at BEO
 We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.
 Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together.
 We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need).
 You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time.
   Next steps
 We move fast. Most processes are completed within 2 weeks. Apply if this sounds like you.

Role
 You’ll take the flexibility of our battery fleet to the short-term power markets (Day-Ahead, Intraday) and develop the trading strategy behind it. Our trading is asset-backed. Every position is backed by real flexibility in our batteries, which sit behind the meter at industrial sites. Available flexibility depends on factory load, site limits and customer needs, and changes every hour.
 Our data scientists optimize how each battery operates at its site. You focus on trading our fleet's flexibility in power markets. Both areas are closely linked, and our quantitative researchers and data scientists work as one team, often across each other's topics. We believe our edge will come from better use of data, new approaches and sharper predictions.
   What you will do
 Developing our trading strategies on Day-Ahead and Intraday, from research and backtesting to live operation.
 Building and improving price forecasts for short-term markets and turning them into trading signals.
 Bidding and trading the fleet's available flexibility under uncertainty and real operational constraints.
 Managing risk: imbalance costs, execution quality and the trade-off between expected value and downside.
 Measuring captured value against clear benchmarks and finding where we can do better.
 Shaping how we access markets and expand to further markets and products as we grow.
 Bringing models into production together with our engineers.
   What we are looking for
 Professional experience in quantitative research, machine learning or data science, ideally in trading or energy. Strategies you have run live are a strong plus.
 Strong in time-series modeling and machine learning, including deep learning, with models that hold up under non-stationarity and regime shifts.
 Solid backtesting practice: realistic assumptions, overfitting controls, walk-forward validation, risk-adjusted metrics.
 You learn new domains fast. Deep knowledge of power markets is not required; our team will get you up to speed.
 Good Python skills and the ambition to write clean code that runs in production, not just in notebooks. You don't need to be a software engineer by training, but you care about code quality and use AI tools to move fast.
 Pragmatic and opinionated: you scope work sensibly, make decisions and don't wait for perfect requirements.
 You enjoy working closely in a small team, learning each other's topics and covering for each other.
 Nice to have: understanding of European short-term power markets, execution and imbalance settlement; experience trading batteries or other flexible assets; optimization under uncertainty; balancing markets. A PhD in a quantitative field is welcome.
   What it means to work at BEO
 We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.

Stéphane HUYGHE
Directeur Division Opération & Gestion d'Actifs

Role
 You’ll build the backend that powers our battery fleet: the services and APIs at the heart of our platform and the control plane of our own fleet management system across all sites. You will work in an interdisciplinary team where software engineers, data scientists and quants build together.
   What you will do
 The role covers two linked areas. You will own at least one of them, and we welcome people who want to work across both:
 Core: Design and build the Python services and APIs at the center of our platform, used by our optimization engine, internal tools and customer products. You own their architecture, scalability, security and code quality. You also contribute to the customer-facing web applications built on these services.
 Fleet Management System: Build the backend that manages our fleet: site and device configuration, getting schedules and commands to each site, and tracking what every site is actually doing. You make sure the right instructions reach the right battery reliably and securely, even when connections or devices fail.
 You will own the backend that our optimization runs on. Your tasks include:
 Design and build backend services and APIs in Python that connect batteries, our optimization engine and our products.
 Own service architecture and make it scale as we grow from pilot sites to thousands of connected battery systems.
 Build security: authentication and authorization, secure APIs, secrets management and safe access to devices on site.
 Build a Fleet Management System control plane: site configuration, schedule and command delivery, site state tracking.
 Build features end to end, from API to UI, for our customer-facing and internal web applications.
 Optimize database performance as data volumes grow with the fleet.
 Write well-tested, maintainable code, review your teammates' work and help set our engineering standards.
   What we are looking for
 Strong Python backend development, ideally with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy
 Proven experience designing APIs and service architectures that are highly scalable, secure and reliable in production
 Solid security practice: authentication, authorization, secure API design, secrets handling, protecting systems connected to physical devices
 Strong PostgreSQL skills: query optimization, indexing and performance tuning, plus comfort with SQL for data exploration and pipeline development
 Willingness to work across the stack, with some experience building web frontends (e.g. React and TypeScript)
 A testing mindset: you write automated tests and care about maintainable code
 You use AI tools to move fast and make pragmatic decisions without perfect requirements
 Nice to have: production AWS experience (ECS, Lambda, EventBridge, RDS); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation); CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting; time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB or similar); building data pipelines; energy sector or IoT experience
   What it means to work at BEO
 We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.
 Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together.
 We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need).
 You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time.
   Next steps
 We move fast. Most processes are completed within 2 weeks. Apply if this sounds like you.

## Über uns
Das Julius Kühn-Institut (JKI) ist das Bundesforschungsinstitut für Kulturpflanzen im Geschäftsbereich des Bundesministeriums für Landwirtschaft, Ernährung und Heimat (BMLEH). An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Praxis und Politik entwickeln wir ressourcenschonende und resiliente Pflanzenbausysteme, um die Lebensgrundlagen von morgen zu sichern.
Das Institut für Resistenzforschung und Stresstoleranz beteiligt sich Verbundvorhaben "BREED-WISE: Breeding Wheat for Improved Soil and Environment: Genotype Plasticity under Resources Challenges“, welches im Rahmen der Forschungsinitiative Green ERA-HUB gefördert werden soll.Wie lässt sich Weizen fit für die Herausforderungen des Klimawandels machen? Das Forschungsprojekt BREED-WISE erforscht innovative Ansätze für eine klimaresiliente und ressourcenschonende Weizenproduktion. Dafür verbindet das Projekt Pflanzenzüchtung, angewandte Genetik, Pflanzenphysiologie, Bodenökologie und modernes Agrarmanagement. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die genetischen Grundlagen einer effizienten Wasser- und Nährstoffnutzung, die Anpassungsfähigkeit verschiedener Weizengenotypen sowie die Wechselwirkungen zwischen Quelle und Senke (Source-Sink-Beziehungen), die Wachstum und Ertragsbildung entscheidend beeinflussen. Durch das Zusammenspiel von Genotyp, Umwelt und Bewirtschaftung will BREED-WISE Ertragsstabilität und Ressourceneffizienz nachhaltig verbessern. Werden Sie Teil eines engagierten Teams, das wissenschaftliche Exzellenz mit unmittelbarer gesellschaftlicher Wirkung verbindet.
## Ihre Aufgaben
- Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von Winterweizen-Feldversuchen mit kontrastierenden Beregnungsintensitäten an den Standorten Quedlinburg und Groß Gerau
- regelmäßige Befliegung der Feldversuche während der Vegetationsperiode mit Drohnen zur multispektralen Reflektanzmessung
- eigenständige Verarbeitung und Analyse der multispektralen Daten, inklusive einer kritischen Prüfung und Sicherstellung der Datenqualität
- tiefgreifende statistische Analysen der erhobenen phänotypischen Daten mithilfe von linearen gemischten Modellen und weiteren modernen Auswertemethoden
- Durchführung einer genomweiten Assoziationsstudie (GWAS) zur Identifizierung von Genomregionen mit Bezug zu Einzelmerkmalen
- Erstellung von genomweiten Haplotypblockkatalogen sowie Schätzung lokaler genomischer Zuchtwerte (localGEBVs) für alle im Projekt erfassten Merkmale
- Entwicklung und Validierung von Vorhersagemodellen unter Nutzung phänomischer und genomischer Daten sowie deren Kombination, inkl. der Nutzung neuer Methoden der künstlichen Intelligenz
- Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von wissenschaftlichen Publikationen in internationalen einschlägigen Fachzeitschriften
- Berichterstattung und Kommunikation der Erkenntnisse auf nationalen und internationalen wissenschaftlichen sowie praxisorientierten Tagungen
- eigenständige Erstellung von wissenschaftlichen Berichten
## Ihre Qualifikationen
- möglichst mit Prädikatsexamen abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (mindestens Masterabschluss, Universitätsdiplom oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) in Pflanzenzüchtung, Agrarwissenschaften, quantitativer Genetik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
- mehrjährige Erfahrung im Feldversuchswesen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Auswahl geeigneter statistischer Versuchsdesigns
- gute Kenntnisse in der Pflanzenzüchtung, insbesondere in den Bereichen genomweite Assoziationsstudien (GWAS), genomische Selektion und genetische Kartierung
- fundierte Kenntnisse der pflanzenphysiologischen Reaktionen von Winterweizen auf abiotischen Stress sowie der Zusammenhänge zwischen Source-Sink-Beziehungen und pflanzlicher Leistungsfähigkeit
- Erfahrung in der Verarbeitung, Analyse und Interpretation umfangreicher phänotypischer und genomischer Datensätze sowie in der Anwendung statistischer Programmiersprachen, vorzugsweise R oder Python
- fundierte Erfahrung in der digitalen Phänotypisierung, insbesondere in der Auswertung multispektraler Fernerkundungsdaten und drohnengestützter Bilddaten.
- Besitz eines Führerscheins der Klasse B sowie eines gültigen EU-Kompetenznachweises für den Drohnenbetrieb und praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Drohnen; alternativ die Bereitschaft, die erforderliche Qualifikation zu erwerben.
- Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Publikationen auf Grundlage eigener Forschungsergebnisse in englischer Sprache sowie in der Vorbereitung von Manuskripten zur Einreichung in begutachteten internationalen Fachzeitschriften (Peer-Review-Journals)
- selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten
- sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
## Das bieten wir
Wir bieten Ihnen eine abwechslungsreiche, anspruchsvolle und interessante Tätigkeit in einer internationalen Arbeitsumgebung mit folgenden Rahmenbedingungen:
- **Arbeitsumfang:** Das Arbeitsverhältnis ist als Vollzeitbeschäftigung mit 39 Wochenstunden vorgesehen. Verschiedene Formen der Teilzeitbeschäftigung sind grundsätzlich möglich.

items.jobDescription:
#### About us
Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
#### Job description
In order to support the EMH Lightning Direct Effects team, Airbus is looking for an
# **Electromagnetic Hazards Lightning Direct Effects Engineer (d/f/m)**
The EMH Lightning Direct Effects team is a highly specialized and multicultural team of engineers working across 4 European nations.
WE contribute to all Aircraft programmes and all phases of development, from R&T and concept, through development and certification,  to inservice support of the flying fleet in the fields of Lightning Direct Effects, Electrostatic Discharge and Electrical Bonding.
WE support AIRBUS Commercial and cross division (e.g. Airbus Helicopters, Airbus Defence and Space, Airbus Canada), as we guide them to design safe, mature and robust systems in all programmes.
## **Your location**
You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
## **Our Benefits for You**
- **Fair Compensation & Extras:** Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- **Time for You (and Your Loved Ones):** 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- **Growth Made Easy:** Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- **Feel Good at Work:** On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- **Diversity Connects:** Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
## **Your tasks and responsibilities**
- You will contribute to our work as a EMH Specialist in the field of Lightning Direct Effects (LDE)  and Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) within the Airbus System Engineering domain
- Your mission will be to influence and trade aircraft architectures and aircraft structures and systems to achieve optimised solutions that are resistant to lightning strike attachment damage and fuel vapour ignition hazards.
- You will contribute to aircraft system architectures and will analyse them in regards to EMH protection and will follow-up certification activities within the certification process.
- You will be involved in a variety of topics like electro-magnetic hazards, standardisation, electrical architectures, certification, environmental qualification
- You will validate the compliance of designs against requirements in accordance to the airworthiness regulations
- You will lead advanced studies to answer programme requests and needs or to solve in-service problems on the flying fleet.
- You will create laboratory, ground and flight tests requests and will be responsible for the flight tests analysis and conclusions and implications to programmes
- You will propose, defend and drive R&T projects and develop the electromagnetic hazard protection strategy in accordance to the team R&T strategy and vision
- You will support the definition of work scope for the EMH related activities, create tasks for internal and sub-contracted partners and will be responsible for the follow-up and steering of the engineering activities.
- These tasks will develop your knowledge in the overall aircraft architecture, the system competence and the understanding of aircraft certification activities and processes.
## **Desired skills and qualifications**
- Experience in lightning direct effects or a closely related field
- Engineering degree educated in aeronautical engineering, electrical engineering, physics (or equivalent academic background)
- Experience in laboratory testing and qualification
- Desire to continuously learn and evolve personally and technically
- Ability to work autonomously as well as being active part of a team
- Good communication skills and ability to simplify complexity
- Solution oriented way of working and anticipation mindset
- Team spirit to continuously strengthen the transnational mindset and exchange
- Negotiation level in English

About the Role
 We are looking for an experienced Systems Engineer for one of our clients operating in the UAV and aerospace industry.
 In this role, you will take end-to-end responsibility for systems engineering activities, from early product concept and requirements definition through functional architecture, subsystem development and validation.
 You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, contribute to safety-critical design decisions and help establish effective systems engineering processes across the organisation.
 Your Responsibilities
 Systems Engineering & Requirements Management 
 Define and maintain top-level product requirements in collaboration with business and engineering stakeholders.
 Develop the Concept of Operations (ConOps), including mission scenarios, operational requirements and system constraints.
 Ensure requirements are complete, verifiable and traceable throughout the development lifecycle.
 Manage requirements changes and assess their impact across subsystems.
 System Architecture & Integration 
 Develop and maintain the product's functional architecture.
 Allocate functions across subsystems, including avionics, flight control, propulsion, power, mechanical systems, communications and ground systems.
 Develop subsystem specifications and manage technical interfaces.
 Support system-level trade-offs involving performance, weight, cost, reliability and safety.
 Safety & Reliability 
 Conduct Functional Hazard Analyses (FHA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (FMEA) at subsystem level.
 Derive safety requirements and integrate findings into architecture and design decisions.
 Document hazards, failure modes, mitigations and safety assumptions.
 Support alignment with applicable regulatory and certification requirements.
 Ground Control Station Development 
 Design and develop ground control station concepts for flight testing and the final product.
 Define operator workflows, command-and-control functions, telemetry requirements and safety procedures.
 Collaborate with software and flight test teams on integration and validation.
 Processes & Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Establish systems engineering processes, methodologies and workflows suited to the product's development stage.
 Develop templates, documentation standards and engineering review processes.
 Train and support engineering teams in applying systems engineering practices.
 Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, software and flight test teams to ensure technical alignment.
 Your Profile
 Required Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Strong professional experience in systems engineering for complex technical products or systems.
 Proven experience in requirements engineering, functional architecture and subsystem specification.
 Hands-on experience with Concept of Operations (ConOps), functional allocation and interface management.
 Practical experience with safety analyses, particularly FHA and FMEA.
 Experience establishing or improving engineering processes and supporting their adoption across teams.
 Strong analytical skills, technical ownership and cross-functional communication abilities.
 Fluency in English.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience in UAVs, aerospace, robotics or other safety-critical engineering environments.
 Familiarity with ground control systems, avionics or flight testing.
 Experience taking products from prototype development towards series production.
 Exposure to regulated industries and certification processes.
 What Makes This Opportunity Interesting?
 Take ownership of systems engineering activities from concept through subsystem development.
 Influence product architecture and safety-critical engineering decisions.
 Help establish and shape systems engineering practices within the organisation.
 Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams on an innovative UAV product.

WE contribute to all Aircraft programmes and all phases of development, from R&T and concept, through development and certification, to inservice support of the flying fleet in the fields of Lightning Direct Effects, Electrostatic Discharge and Electrical Bonding.
WE support AIRBUS Commercial and cross division (e.g. Airbus Helicopters, Airbus Defence and Space, Airbus Canada), as we guide them to design safe, mature and robust systems in all programmes.
 Your location
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Our Benefits for You

 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities
 You will contribute to our work as a EMH Specialist in the field of Lightning Direct Effects (LDE) and Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) within the Airbus System Engineering domain 
 Your mission will be to influence and trade aircraft architectures and aircraft structures and systems to achieve optimised solutions that are resistant to lightning strike attachment damage and fuel vapour ignition hazards.

 Desire to continuously learn and evolve personally and technically

Organisation
 NAVAL GROUP Acteur international du naval de défense, Naval Group est partenaire des États dans la maîtrise de leur souveraineté maritime. Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires
 Description Du Poste
 Naval Group recrute, pour son site de Saint-Tropez un Architecte système Energie-Propulsion en charge de l’architecture des réseaux électriques et communications de véhicules sous-marin, de la spécification du besoin, jusqu’à la validation des essais.
Au sein de la Direction Industrielle de DSA (Drones, Systèmes Autonomes et Armes sous-marines) qui produit, commercialise et assure la maintenance de nombreux équipements et systèmes sous-marins, des torpilles aux contre-mesures en passant par les drones et les systèmes de lancement, vous rejoignez le service en charge de l’architecture des systèmes de plateformes et d’energie.
A ce titre, vous devrez :
 Réaliser les travaux d’architecture du système « véhicule » en phase programme sur le périmètre du réseau électrique et communication
 Assurer la cohérence d'ensemble des spécifications des exigences des sous-ensembles constitutifs (appareils de protection électrique, capteurs, charges utiles, …)
 Animer l'amélioration continue du système en prenant en compte le retour d'expérience des programmes
 Contribuer à l’élaboration des feuilles de route Energie/réseau électrique/propulsion et du Référentiel Normatif et Technique
 Coordonner la cohérence d'ensemble de l'offre technico-financière du système
 Les missions ne sont pas exhaustives et peuvent évoluer dans le temps.
Naval Group s’engage dans l’évolution de ses collaborateurs, que celle-ci soit dans le domaine technique, le management ou encore la gestion de projet. Être collaborateur chez Naval Group, c’est avoir la possibilité de vivre un parcours qui vous ressemble en adéquation avec vos envies et les besoins du groupe.
 Profil
 De formation ingénieur en génie électrique bac+5 avec une spécialisation dans les systèmes embarqués, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 8 ans minimum vous ayant permis de mettre en pratique plusieurs des connaissances et compétences suivantes : - Réseau électrique à courant continu (appareils de protection du domaine basse tension, capteurs de mesures, connectiques, ...) - Compatibilité électromagnétique et filtrage associée - Systèmes communicants (Bus CAN, ETH, liaison série...) - Electronique et informatiques embarquées - Électronique de puissance et machines électriques - Batteries Lithium et Battery Management System Une expérience dans l’un des domaines et/ou outils suivants serait également appréciée : PSIM, suite OrCAD, processus d’Intégration-Vérification-Validation (IVV) des systèmes électriques, Télécommunications (4G, UHF, Wifi, GPS/SATCOM,…), programmation informatique (C, C++), Cybersécurité des réseaux informatiques, . Pour mener à bien vos missions, les qualités suivantes sont attendues : - Bon relationnel - Curiosité technique - Capacité de synthèse - Autonomie - Fort attrait pour l’innovation Naval Group est convaincu que la diversité est une richesse pour l’entreprise et un atout pour sa performance. C’est pourquoi nous soutenons l’égalité entre les femmes et les hommes et favorisons l’insertion professionnelle, l’accès et le maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

 Industrial Engineering und Management
 Berufsbegleitendes Fernstudium im Fachgebiet Industrial Engineering und Management
 Die Weiterbildungsangebote Industrial Management, Führung, Technisches Management und Produktion sind jeweils in sich abgeschlossene Studienbereiche und entsprechen inhaltlich dem Master-Fernstudiengang Industrial Engineering und Management. 
 Industrial Engineering und Management ist die moderne Weiterentwicklung des seit 1999 angebotenen Masterstudiums Industrial Engineering. 
 Studienziel 
 Erwerb von Schlüsselkompetenzen für das ganzheitliche Verstehen, Gestalten und Weiterentwickeln von Unternehmensprozessen 
 In jedem der vier speziellen Bildungsangebote wird ein umfangreiches, interdisziplinäres Wissen zur Lösung von betrieblichen Aufgaben vermittelt. Das moderne „blended learning“-Konzept dieser Weiterbildung enthält einen abgestimmten Mix aus Präsenzphasen, Selbstlernphasen und Studienbegleitung durch ein Online-Forum. Dadurch ermöglicht jedes dieser Bildungsangebote das berufsbegleitende und flexible Lernen.

 „ingenium“ ist lateinisch und steht für sinnreiche Erfindung oder Scharfsinn
 Der Kurs soll einen Einblick in ein ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium und die mit der Technik verbundenen Fragestellungen geben. Dabei sollen einerseits ingenieurstechnische Grundlagen vermittelt werden sowie Probleme des Alltags beispielhaft analysiert werden.
 „Wie kommt der Strom in die Steckdose?“
 „Was passiert, wenn ich eine WhatsApp verschicke?“
 Gleichzeitig soll auch diskutiert werden, welche gesellschaftliche Verantwortung wir als Ingenieure haben.
 „Welche technischen Lösungen helfen uns im Kampf gegen den Klimawandel?“
 „Macht autonomes Fahren unsere Straßen wirklich sicherer?“
 Zusätzlich wird es eine Einführung in wissenschaftliches Schreiben geben. In diesem Kursabschnitt soll gezeigt werden, was genau unter Forschung zu verstehen ist, wie Konferenzen ablaufen und welche Vorteile die Makrosprache LaTeX gegenüber Word hat.  In einem praktischen Teil sollen die Kollegiat:innen ein kurzes Dokument (bspw. Lebenslauf) in LaTeX schreiben.
 Damit jeder herausfinden kann, ob ein Ingenieursstudium für einen infrage kommt, werden neben den technischen Aspekten auch Themen wie Studienwahl, Auslandssemester, Berufsperspektiven, Gehalt und Arbeitsalltag von Ingenieuren behandelt.
 Der Kurs soll möglichst interaktiv aufgebaut werden. Neben kurzen Vorlesungsanteilen sollen Inhalte gemeinsam erarbeitet werden. Fragen und Diskussionen, speziell zu den gesellschaftlichen Themen, sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

# Projektsteuerer Gebäude- und Energietechnik (m/w/d) Wärmeversorgung in Stuttgart 
Du brennst für Tech- und Consulting- Projekte? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Bei PROGNUM sind wir als etablierter Ingenieur- und Personaldienstleister darauf spezialisiert, in vielseitigen Projekten neue Maßstäbe zu setzen. Wir arbeiten an den wegweisenden Technologien von morgen – sei es Automotive, IT oder anderen Tech-Branchen.
Sichere Dir die Pole-Position und starte mit uns durch!
## Was Dich erwartet
Selbstständige Bearbeitung und Koordination standardisierbarer Wärmeumstellungen mit einer thermischen Leistung unter 1 MW – von der Bestandsaufnahme über Planung und Vergabe bis zur Inbetriebnahme und geordneten Übergabe.
- Aufnehmen und Bewerten bestehender Wärmeerzeugungsanlagen, hydraulischer Systeme, Regelungstechnik, Medienanschlüsse und räumlicher Randbedingungen.
- Festlegen und Abstimmen geeigneter Umstellungslösungen, etwa Wärmepumpe, Fern- oder Nahwärme, Biomasse, Hybridanlage oder elektrische Spitzenlastabdeckung.
- Erarbeiten beziehungsweise Prüfen einfacher technischer Konzepte, Dimensionierungen, Schemata, Kostenansätze und Terminpläne.
- Koordinieren externer Planungsbüros, ausführender Firmen, Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber, Behörden, Nutzer und Gebäudebetrieb.
- Vorbereiten und Begleiten von Ausschreibungen, Angebotsprüfungen, Vergaben und Beauftragungen.
- Überwachen der Umsetzung hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten, Terminen, Arbeitssicherheit, Bestandsschutz und laufendem Gebäudebetrieb.
- Organisieren von Abschaltungen, Provisorien, Umschaltungen, Funktionsprüfungen, Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahmen.
- Prüfen und Nachhalten von Rechnungen, Nachträgen, Mängeln, Revisionsunterlagen sowie Einweisungs- und Übergabenachweisen.
- Fortschreiben des Projektstatus und frühzeitiges Eskalieren von Abweichungen und Entscheidungsbedarfen.
## Das bringst Du mit
Fachliche Mindestanforderungen
- Abschluss als staatlich geprüfte Technikerin/staatlich geprüfter Techniker oder abgeschlossenes Studium in einer einschlägigen Fachrichtung.
- Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung in Planung, Bauleitung, Betrieb oder Projektabwicklung von Heizungs- und Energieanlagen.
- Gute Kenntnisse von Wärmeerzeugern, Hydraulik, Mess-, Steuer- und Regelungstechnik sowie technischen Gebäudeanschlüssen.
- Erfahrung in der Koordination ausführender Unternehmen und in der Abnahme technischer Anlagen.
- Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Baustellen- und Liegenschaftsterminen.
Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen 
- Erfahrung mit Wärmepumpen, Wärmenetzanschlüssen, fossilfreien oder hybriden Versorgungslösungen.
- 
- Kenntnisse der VOB, einschlägiger DIN-/VDI-Regelwerke, des GEG sowie grundlegender HOAI-Prozesse.
- Praxis in öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren und Baumaßnahmen im laufenden Betrieb.
- Erfahrung in AVA- oder Projektmanagementsystemen.
Persönliche und methodische Kompetenzen

- Idealerweise Erfahrung mit ECSS-Standards und regulierten Entwicklungsumgebungen.

**Das wäre außerdem von Vorteil:**
- Erfahrung mit modellbasiertem Systems Engineering (MBSE), beispielsweise mit SysML oder Capella.
- Kenntnisse in Rust oder anderen speichersicheren Programmiersprachen.

**Das erwartet dich:**

Last but not least: Sag uns vor allem, was Dir wichtig ist, damit wir gemeinsam entscheiden, ob dieser Job der Richtige ist. Denn egal, an welcher beruflichen Station Du Dich gerade befindest, wir begleiten Dich genau nach deinen Vorstellungen in Deiner neuen Zukunft: Mit Herz und Verstand!

items.jobDescription:
#### About us
Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
#### Job description
In order to support the Mission Support Systems department in Manching, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a
# **System Engineer for Mission Support System (d/f/m)**
In Platform Operational Support, we develop Mission Planning Systems, consisting of commercial IT-Infrastructure and custom software, for all flying platforms in our portfolio and Future Platforms.
Within the Mission Systems organization, we want to incorporate to our team a Systems Engineer within the scope of Mission Planning Systems.
## **Your location**
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.
## **Our Benefits for You**
- **Fair Compensation & Extras:** Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- **Time for You (and Your Loved Ones):** 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- **Growth Made Easy:** Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- **Feel Good at Work:** On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- **Diversity Connects:** Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
## **Your tasks and responsibilities**
- Analysis of customer requirements
- Creation of the system and subsystem concept and design, taking into account the existing product reference architecture and compliance with the applicable norms and standards
- Definition of interfaces with other systems and sub-systems
- Preparation of the technical requirements documentation (specifications)
- Integrate, verify, qualify, certify and ensure the continued airworthiness of the vehicle mission systems used to perform different kind of missions
- Continuous improvement and expansion of the product based on different domain products and new technologies
## **Desired skills and qualifications**
- Master in Aeronautical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics or similar
- At least 5 years of professional experience in Systems Engineering activities
- Knowledge and experience in the field of Model based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and system engineering tools such as DOORS and Cameo
- Experience in implementing regulations and standards like DO178/278
- Experience in working using agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, SAFe) and Tools (e.g. JIRA and Confluence) would be a plus
- Experience in Mission Planning would be a plus
- Good written and spoken English (project language); German is a plus
Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
Take your career to a new level and apply [online](https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!
\#MYCYM
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth
By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. 
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This Position reports to:
Engineering Manager - MV Drives
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.
The work model for the role is: 
This role is contributing to the Motion business for High Power division in Nelmangala - Bangalore, India
You will be mainly accountable for:
 Preparation of order specific customer drawings and production documentation of various families of MV VFDs (up to 11kV – both VSI/LCI converters), including soft-starting applications.
 Discussion with customer/consultant for approval of drawings and during inspection in factory. 
 Maintain on time generation of drawings and achieving desired quality levels (first pass yield/defects per unit).
 Coordination with factories in other locations for engineering documentation (for imported VSI/LCI converters). 
 Participate in special testing requirements at other factories or customer sites.
 Preparation of specification and evaluation of vendors of packaging project supplies like converter transformers, induction and synchronous motors, LV and MV switchgear panels, UPS, excitation system, PLC panels, cables, harmonics filters, bus ducts, vibration monitoring system, lubrication system, chiller, finfan cooler.
 Provide technical support to sales on specific topics.
 Ensure safety & integrity and other code of conduct compliance within the team.
 Qualifications For The Role
 Familiarity and practice of all safety requirements including procedures, PPE, best practices, hazard reporting etc.
 Experience with engineering and testing of variable speed drives, and associated IEC/IS standards and software tools for dimensioning & configuring MV VFD systems.
 Experience of addressing drive system level topics like protection coordination, network harmonics, resonance effects, torque pulsation etc.
 Familiarity with operation and maintenance of switchgear, PLC, motors, transformers.
 Familiarity with SAP and CAD tool like Eplan/ECSCAD/ACAD Electrical/Solid Edge/Creo.
 Familiarity with typical MV VFD application in industries like cement, metals, power, chemicals, oil & gas, tire and typical purchase specifications of industry consultants.
 Bachelor’s degree – Electrical Engineering, with 4+ years of experience with MV variable speed drive systems
 More About Us
 ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.
 We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.jobDescription:
Job Description
 🚀 MaiaSpace is a European space tech company, designing, manufacturing and operating competitive and sustainable solutions for space mobility. We are driven by the belief that access to space is a major enabler for a better and more sustainable life on Earth, addressing the challenges faced by humanity: climate, resources, connectivity, and data. Our aim is to successfully design and test a cost-effective and reusable mini-launch vehicle by 2026. 🚀
 Upper Stage Propulsion Engine System Technical Leader 
 Within MaiaSpace Technical Team, you’ll be in charge of the overall Engines Propulsion Systems:
 Manage the engine specification for MSP launcher and ensure convergence and consistency with all the architects of the launcher and with the Upper stage architect). A particular attention, on the launcher exploitation phase must be considered aiming to optimize Expendable Launch Vehicle and Reusable Launch Vehicle business performance. 
 Contribute to the launcher development and verification plan with a strong link with tests (objectives, exploitation and measurement plan) 
 Contribution to the tests and flight preparation (i.e flight worthiness file), forecast, and analysis 
 Manage First stage Engine technical data base, configuration management and coordination planning activities with Engines supplier. 
 Draw and Manage with Engines supplier the technical logic and actions plan regarding technical issues 
 Ensure consistency with First stage Engine system design 
 Monitor target engine performance under development worldwide 
 Your duties will include:
Design (Mechanical, Functional & Avionics)
 Concept studies, including trade-offs 
 Technical specification Requirements 
 Functional and justification files synthesis for MSP 
 Safety file 
 Roadmap and logics i.e tests 
 Supplier management
 Ensure coordination and convergence 
 Support to the company’s technical strategy
 Support to the Propulsion roadmap 
 Support to industrialization and operation 
 Job Requirements
 🎓 Qualification 
 Master’s degree or equivalent in aerospace engineering 
 > 10 years of professional experience in the field of liquid propulsion and launcher systems 
 Sound knowledge in fluid systems, avionics systems and mechanical architecture, design and development 
 Sound knowledge of cryogenic fluids, control and regulation, mechanical justification 
 Sound knowledge of launcher system architecture design (function analysis, phase analysis, specification...) 
 Sound knowledge in products and supplier management 
 Sound knowledge in test and launch campaign preparation 
 Experience with development and qualification process 
 🛸 Skills 
 Customers oriented 
 Autonomous, proactive attitude towards resolution of problem 
 Team player with the ability to collaborate with people from different disciplines and cultures 
 Curious, pragmatic and capacity to arbitrate and make choice to guarantee the launcher optimization 
 Negotiation skills 
 Knowledge or practice of Agile methodology 
 🎬 Working at MaiaSpace 
 You will be joining a friendly multi-disciplinary team, comprised of multi-skilled people, following Agile and Scrum methodologies. This means that your role and responsibility may evolve over time with varied assignments and challenges depending on priorities and competences. Your work will be hands-on and in close contact with the final product. We are open-minded, transparent, pragmatic, result oriented and people centric. Teamwork is at the heart of how we work together and our co-workers share the same fundamental values: respect, humility, reactivity and autonomy with a passion for technical excellence. Our newly acquired office space at La Defense is located within the heart of Europe’s largest purpose built business and commercial district with easy access to public transport.
Written and spoken communication is in French and English.
📢 We're hiring ! Check out our Career page. ✨

Über die Prokuras Gruppe
 Prokuras ist eine deutschlandweit agierende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich des Immobilien- und Gebäudemanagements.  Für den Aufbau eines kleinen, leistungsfähigen IT-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Junior IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) .

 Funktion und Verantwortlichkeiten
 IT-Support: Du unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden und Partnerunternehmen bei technischen Fragen und bearbeitest Supportanfragen im First- und Second-Level-Support. Bei komplexeren Problemen arbeitest du gemeinsam mit dem Senior IT-Systemadministrator an einer Lösung.
 Microsoft 365 & Cloud: Du unterstützt bei der Administration unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebungen und übernimmst zunehmend eigenständig Standardaufgaben in Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online und OneDrive.

 Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen

 Erste Praxiserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du erste Erfahrungen im IT-Support oder in der Systemadministration gesammelt, beispielsweise während deiner Ausbildung, durch Praktika, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder erste Berufserfahrung.
 Microsoft 365: Du kennst Microsoft 365 aus der Praxis und hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit den zugehörigen Administrationsoberflächen gesammelt.

 Benutzerverwaltung: Kenntnisse in Active Directory und idealerweise Microsoft Entra ID.
 Arbeitsweise: Selbstständige, strukturierte und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen und Mitarbeitende zu unterstützen.
 Leistungen und Benefits
